name: Civ Robotics CivNav Pile Driving
specialisedFor: utility-scale solar construction: driving tracker foundation piles
summary: GPS machine-control and automation kit for solar pile drivers: after one button press the machine navigates to the next pile, positions and plumbs the hammer and drives the pile to the target elevation, with a machine-mounted tablet for guidance.

germany.statusNote: Sold or rented direct by the US maker on request (pricing page: 'Rental and purchase options for CivNav', formal quote). No German or EU distributor, office or CE information found, as for Civ's CivDot robots.

sellers.name: Civ Robotics Inc.
sellers.note: 638 4th Street, San Francisco; buy or rent with a formal quote. No German or EU office, distributor or reseller found.

specs.label: Automated steps
specs.value: pile-to-pile navigation, positioning, plumbing, driving to target elevation
specs.quote: positioning, plumbing, and driving each pile to target elevation, with real-time guidance on a rugged, machine-mounted tablet

specs.label: Piling cycle time reduction
specs.quote: reduce the piling cycle time by up to 50%, with a single operator managing the entire process

notes: Kit only: GPS machine control mounted on a pile driver; the pile driver (carrier, mast and hammer) is not part of the product, so handsIncluded is false. Which pile driver models it fits is not stated.
tracks, roughGround and outdoor describe the typical solar pile driver it is fitted to, not a sourced spec.
The page also calls it 'Solar pile driving and drilling automation'; live map shows machine position, plumbness and pile height.
